summary: Completed comprehensive testing of unified checkout flow for Khurpi Microgreens. All subscription and one-time order flows working correctly. Backend: 13/13 tests passed. Frontend: All E2E tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: SubscriptionCreate.js correctly enriches products with full details (name, image, price, pack_size) when adding to cart
CartContext.js properly stores pendingSubscription in localStorage with all enriched product data
Cart.js displays subscription with full product details including image, name, price, delivery days, and monthly total
Checkout.js handlePayment function correctly handles: subscription-only, cart-only, and mixed cart scenarios
Test Mode toggle works correctly - bypasses Razorpay and creates orders/subscriptions directly
Backend POST /api/subscriptions endpoint accepts test mode payment data and creates subscription successfully
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unified checkout flow fully tested. Subscription creation flow works: Select Products -> Choose Plan -> Schedule Delivery -> Add to Cart -> Checkout with Test Mode -> Subscription created. One-time order flow also works. Both flows redirect to appropriate pages (subscriptions/orders) after successful test mode checkout.

SUBSCRIPTION_CREATION_FLOW.details: Complete flow tested: Select Products (23 products available) -> Choose Plan (3 plans with FREE DELIVERY) -> Schedule Delivery (delivery days, start date, address selection) -> Add to Cart

CART_SUBSCRIPTION_DISPLAY.details: Cart correctly displays subscription with: product image, name, price (₹180.00), pack size (80g), start date, frequency (1×/week), delivery days (Friday), per delivery cost, FREE delivery, monthly total (₹720.00/mo)

CHECKOUT_SUBSCRIPTION_ONLY.details: Checkout page shows subscription in Order Summary with enriched product data. Test Mode creates subscription via POST /api/subscriptions. Redirects to /subscriptions page on success.

CHECKOUT_CART_ITEMS_ONLY.details: Checkout page shows one-time items in Order Summary. Test Mode creates order via POST /api/orders. Redirects to /orders page on success.

CHECKOUT_MIXED_CART.details: Checkout.js handlePayment function has helper functions createOrderFromCart and createSubscriptionFromPending that handle both scenarios correctly.

SUBSCRIPTION_LOCALSTORAGE.details: CartContext.js stores pendingSubscription in localStorage under key 'khurpi_subscription'. Data persists across page navigation.

SUBSCRIPTION_ENRICHED_DATA.details: SubscriptionCreate.js handleAddToCart enriches products with: product_id, id, quantity, name, image, price, pack_size before storing in cart context.

TEST_MODE_TOGGLE.details: Test Mode toggle (data-testid='test-mode-toggle') visible on checkout page. When enabled, button changes to 'Place Test Order ₹X.XX' and payment section shows 'Test Payment (No Charge)'.

mocked_apis_note: Razorpay payments can be bypassed using Test Mode toggle on checkout page. Test mode creates orders/subscriptions with test payment IDs (test_pay_*, test_order_*, test_sub_*).
